title: Project overview / initial project handoff
name: Project overview / initial project handoff
audience: Human adopting or opening a project; agent consuming the same facts
scope: One explicitly identified project, in its actual checkout for item work
trigger: Project onboarding handoff, first project visit, or explicit request for an overview
current: Projects has a roster and settings detail, while Strategy/Frontier/Shipping carry substantive work. No current combined Overview route exists.
proposed_purpose: Explain this project’s operating model and the next useful action, without replaying global setup.
content: Which universe, project and checkout this is.
What the project is for and the accepted current plan; identify templates or missing direction honestly.
What existing work is being adopted and what remains outside the agreed intake.
How this project builds, tests and ships; whether it is merge-only or has configured delivery.
Where its project guidance lives and which workflow/policies the next item actually uses.
How to act: ask the agent to plan or run work; use Strategy, Frontier, Sessions and Inbox to inspect or decide.
One useful next step, with deeper setup offered only when the task needs it.
authority_and_reuse: Project facts come from current project/strategy/workflow/capability/checklist reads. An agent can render the concise handoff; a compact Projects detail/onboarding card can link the same facts. Do not create a new monolithic dashboard Overview or copy this snapshot into permanent policy prose.
proposal_status: Proposed shared fact projection and human rendering; exact placement remains reviewable
